children: The Indonesia Stock Exchange said on Monday it cut its lower auto-rejection limit to 7% from 15%, effective immediately and to be reassessed periodically.

"This adjustment is aimed at giving investors an opportunity to evaluate and digest available information, helping them make better investment decisions based on Indonesia's economic fundamentals," the exchange said in a statement.
